# CoArt Studio

> CoArt Studio is a human-first digital agency in Dubai. Real designers, strategists, and developers craft brand identities, custom websites, mobile apps, AI automation, and digital marketing for businesses that want human expertise behind their technology.

## About

CoArt Studio exists because the best digital work still comes from people who understand people. We use AI as a tool, not a replacement for creative thinking, strategic judgement, and the human connection that makes brands resonate. We work with startups, entrepreneurs, and established businesses across industries.

## Services

### Brand Identity Design
We craft brand identities by hand, informed by strategy and built to connect with real people. Services include logo and visual identity design, brand strategy and positioning, brand guidelines, and pitch decks and collateral. Brands refreshed by CoArt report 35% stronger audience recall within 60 days.

### Web & Mobile App Development
We design and build human-centric digital products: websites, mobile apps, and SaaS platforms where every interaction feels intentional. Services include custom web applications, mobile app development (iOS and Android), e-commerce and SaaS platforms, and API and backend architecture. CoArt clients see an average 2.4x lift in online conversions after launch.

### AI-Powered Automation
We integrate AI thoughtfully into business operations, always with human expertise guiding the strategy. AI handles the repetitive work so teams can focus on the creative, strategic, and relational work that humans do best. Services include AI search optimization (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini), business AI integration, AI lead generation, and workflow automation. CoArt AI clients report up to 70% reduction in manual workload within the first 90 days.

### Digital Marketing
We build marketing strategies rooted in understanding real audiences, not just algorithms. From social media content that connects with communities to SEO that earns organic visibility, every campaign is shaped by human insight. Services include social media management, SEO and content strategy, paid advertising (Google and Meta), and performance analytics. CoArt marketing clients average a 3x increase in qualified leads within the first 90 days.
